name: auto-continue
description: When the 5-hour usage limit is hit, wait for the reset and send "continue" automatically.

threshold.title: Show button at % of 5-hour limit used
threshold.description: The Auto-continue button appears above the prompt once the 5-hour window is at least this full.

graceMinutes.title: Minutes to wait after the reset
graceMinutes.description: Extra margin after the reset time before sending the message.

message.title: Message to send on resume
message.description: The prompt submitted when the limit resets.
